quotes: I have seen worse roads, and better breakfasts.
Give me a quiet morning and a useful task.
The frontier feels kinder when we share the load.
I can hear a loose gear from three rooms away.
There is always one more ridge worth seeing.
A warm lantern makes any ruin feel almost friendly.
I learned to mend things before I learned to complain.
If the kettle sings, the day cannot be all bad.
